checks.what: Sealed predictions scored against official final scores
checks.detail: margin MAE 15.9 pts, total MAE 14.6 pts, side picked 0.6 on n=10, Brier 0.3479 on n=10; reliability 0.0-0.4→0.50 (n=4), 0.4-0.6→1.00 (n=2), 0.6-1.0→0.50 (n=4) — settled means an official final score with its own URL exists for that game id. A projection with no result is listed as unsettled, never as a push, and no cover figure is published because no market price exists to cover. 21 of the 39 unsettled are simply unplayed (scheduled after 2026-11-15); 18 sit on or before the capture date with no final on disk.

injury_pdf_prior.fields: Read independently and compared row by row with the newest release: re-read independently and compared row by row: the only difference between the two 11/15 releases is the spelling of one Philadelphia surname; no status, team, reason or game moved

players.fields: Per-player GP, MIN, PTS, REB, AST for the rows used on this site.

games.fields: final scores, game status; the dated finals rows in this build come from games_2026_11_14 and results_feed, both of which link here

odds.what: Market prices (spread, total, moneyline, prop lines)
odds.why: No licensed odds feed is connected and NBA.com renders odds client-side only. Required for: any value/edge claim, stake sizing, ROI, leaderboard scoring.

live_ingest.what: An automated feed that keeps the results history current without a human capture
live_ingest.why: The 188 official finals from 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-14 are committed under data/raw/, and they rebuild every one of the 30 standings records exactly - including all 30 conference records. What is missing is a scheduled job that can reach nba.com, so the history freezes between manual captures and the window ages.

player_box.what: Per-player season game logs (minutes by game, usage, on/off)
player_box.why: nba.com/stats player pages render season aggregates only for this client, and the game-log view returns 'No data available'. Required for: minutes distributions, prop probabilities, and a replacement model that does not depend on one day's game book.

future_injuries.why: Narrower than it was yesterday and still real. For 11/15 a full report exists (84 rows across 16 clubs). For 11/16 the report exists but every one of the 16 club-slots prints NOT YET SUBMITTED. For 11/17 the document contains no rows at all. A team files by 5 p.m. local the day before, so these deadlines had not passed at capture time.

game_book_shooting_lines.what: Team shooting lines from the official game books
game_book_shooting_lines.why: None of the six that this session could read satisfies 2 x FGM + FTM = points, the arithmetic every NBA box must satisfy, because the PDF text layer misaligns columns. They are published as defects on the review page and discarded from every calculation; the team-level points, quarters and results come from the reconciled game pages instead.
